speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details; the 11-pound baby and prolonged labor are significant risk factors for a difficult delivery. Given the decreased bowel sounds, uterine tenderness, and fever, could you tell me if you are currently passing any clots or if you notice any foul-smelling vaginal discharge?
